map.为何不是简单相加？: Why not simply add them up?
map.dB 是对数单位，声强可加、声级不可直接加，须先转声强再求和。结果按公开标准与环: dB is a logarithmic unit: sound intensities add, but sound levels cannot be added directly; convert to intensity first and then sum.
